Data Entry Officer Job at Davidorlah Farms




        
    

        
        Davidorlah Farms is a pineapple farm estate developer and management service company that specialises in pineapple farming and distribution of all kinds of fresh fruits/healthy fruits and vegetables in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Data Entry Officer 

Job Location: Lagos

Job Description


	In this role, you’ll help ensure that critical farm, production, inventory, sales and operational records are accurately captured, maintained and readily available to support better decision-making.


Responsibilities
What you’ll do:
     

            
    




	Capture and update farm production and yield records.
	Maintain inventory, stock movement and equipment records.
	Verify data against field reports, receipts and other source documents.
	Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports.
	Identify and flag data discrepancies.
	Support Finance, Procurement, Logistics and Business Intelligence teams with data.
	Maintain accurate and confidential company and client records.


Requirements
What we’re looking for:


	OND, HND or BSc in any discipline.
	1–2 years of experience in data entry or administration.
	Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets.
	Familiarity with ERP or database systems.
	Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
	Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
	Experience with Pivot Tables, Power BI or other reporting tools is an advantage.
	Agribusiness/farm operations experience is a plus.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

At Duotech HR Consulting, we believe that people are the driving force behind every successful organization.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

	Our organization seeks to engage the services of a diligent and results-oriented Customer Service Executive with a background in real estate.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for managing client relationships, generating qualified leads, and providing dedicated support to the sales function.


Core Responsibilities


	Attend to client inquiries and provide comprehensive after-sales support
	Undertake cold calling activities to identify and generate prospective leads
	Diligently follow up on prospective clients with a view to converting inquiries into property viewings and sales
	Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of clients and leads within the CRM system
	Liaise closely with the sales team to ensure attainment of set targets
	Cultivate and sustain professional relationships with clients and referral partners


Requirements


	A Bachelor Degree in Communication, Marketing, orBusiness Administration
	A minimum of three (3) years of relevant experience in customer service, preferably within the real estate sector
	Demonstrable sales acumen, including proven competence in cold calling and lead generation
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills
	A target-driven disposition with a professional and persuasive manner
	Must be resident in Abuja.


Salary

We deliver innovative, data-driven HR solutions across recruitment, talent acquisition, organizational development, learning and development, performance management, and workforce consulting.

With a strong focus on professionalism, integrity, and measurable results, we partner with businesses to build high-performing teams while connecting top talent with meaningful career opportunities. At Duotech HR Consulting, we believe that people are the driving force behind every successful organization.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:
     

            
    



 Job Position: Customer Service Executive 

Job Location: Maitama, Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview


	Our organization seeks to engage the services of a diligent and results-oriented Customer Service Executive with a background in real estate.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for managing client relationships, generating qualified leads, and providing dedicated support to the sales function.


Core Responsibilities


	Attend to client inquiries and provide comprehensive after-sales support
	Undertake cold calling activities to identify and generate prospective leads
	Diligently follow up on prospective clients with a view to converting inquiries into property viewings and sales
	Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of clients and leads within the CRM system
	Liaise closely with the sales team to ensure attainment of set targets
	Cultivate and sustain professional relationships with clients and referral partners


Requirements


	A Bachelor Degree in Communication, Marketing, orBusiness Administration
	A minimum of three (3) years of relevant experience in customer service, preferably within the real estate sector
	Demonstrable sales acumen, including proven competence in cold calling and lead generation
	Excellent verbal and written communication skills
	A target-driven disposition with a professional and persuasive manner
	Must be resident in Abuja.


Salary
N160,000 - N200,000 per month.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Cost Accountant 

Job Location: Ogun

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Purpose
     

            
    




	The Cost Accountant will be responsible for monitoring and analyzing the costs associated with the production and operations of the aluminum and copper recycling plant.
	The role involves ensuring cost efficiency, preparing detailed cost reports, and providing actionable insights to support financial and operational decision-making.


Key Responsibilities
Cost Analysis and Reporting:


	Analyze costs incurred in production processes, including raw material procurement, labor, and overhead.
	Develop detailed cost reports and variance analyses to monitor performance against budget.
	Provide insights into cost-saving opportunities and process improvements.


Inventory and Fixed Asset Management:


	Manage the valuation of raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished goods inventory.
	Ensure accurate cost allocation and reconciliation of inventory.
	Maintain and monitor the fixed asset register for the plant.


Budgeting and Forecasting:


	Collaborate with the finance and operations teams to prepare annual budgets and forecasts.
	Monitor and report variances between actual costs and budgets, providing explanations and corrective actions where necessary.


Cost Control and Optimization:


	Implement cost control measures and track their effectiveness.
	Conduct profitability analysis for different production lines and product categories.


Compliance and Internal Controls:


	Ensure adherence to accounting standards, company policies, and regulatory requirements.
	Establish and maintain robust internal controls related to costing processes.


Data Management and Reporting Tools:


	Develop and maintain cost accounting systems, tools, and reports.
	Utilize ERP systems for real-time cost tracking and analysis.


Collaboration and Support:


	Work closely with the production, procurement, and logistics teams to ensure accurate cost data.
	Provide support during internal and external audits by preparing cost-related reports and documentation.


Qualifications and Experience


	Education: Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. A professional qualification (e.g., ACA, ACCA, CMA) is highly desirable.
	Experience: Minimum of 7 years of experience as a Cost Accountant or similar role, preferably in a manufacturing or recycling industry.


Technical Skills:


	Proficiency in cost accounting principles and practices.
	Strong knowledge of ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and advanced Excel skills.
	Familiarity with industry-specific costing methods and inventory valuation techniques.


Soft Skills:


	Analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving abilities.
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills for cross-functional collaboration.
	Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

title: Job Openings at SNV Nigeria
content:
SNV is a not-for-profit international development organisation that makes a lasting difference in the lives of people living in poverty by helping them raise incomes and access basic services. We focus on only three sectors and have a long-term, local presence in over 25 countries in Asia, Africa and Latin America. Our team of more than 1,300 staff is the backbone of SNV.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Research Assistant 

Job Location: Abuja

Job type: Full-time
Employment Type: Internship
Expected start date: October 1, 2026

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking to recruit a Research Assistant for Internship/National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) for its Country Programme, to provide support with conducting research, knowledge generation, analyse data and support with preparation of briefs within its programme implementation across its Agriculture, Renewable Energy and Water portfolios.


Purpose of the internship Placement 


	In your role as a Research Assistant, you will gain practical experience in research and data analysis and programme implementation within an international development organisation.
	The intern will be based in Abuja, work with the Programme and project team, across SNV Nigeria’s portfolio, contributing to a range of initiatives that strengthens SNV’s objectives and visibility.
	The intern will report to the Country Director and will take on, a mix of research and data analysis tasks within the dynamic programmes. Each week will offer opportunities to learn, co-create, and contribute in meaningful ways.
	To succeed in this role, you should bring a flexible and proactive mindset, a collaborative spirit, and a genuine passion for our mission to advance sustainable and equitable development, making impact that matters. 


Job Description


	Conduct desk research on agriculture, agribusiness, renewable energy, water and climate-related issues relevant to SNV programmes.
	Support programme teams with data collection, analysis and interpretation for projects and assignments.
	Track relevant market, policy, technology and investment developments across agriculture, renewable energy and water sectors.
	Prepare concise research briefs, literature reviews, presentations, factsheets and programme inputs.
	Support mapping and profiling of private-sector companies, government institutions, development partners and other stakeholders.
	Assist in gathering and analysing information on value chains, markets, business models and investment opportunities.
	Support field research, interviews, surveys and stakeholder consultations where required.
	Contribute to preparation of project reports, concept notes, proposals, ToRs and other technical documents.
	Support programme team in monitoring project activities and compiling relevant evidence and documentation.
	Organise and maintain research databases, reference materials and project information.
	Support knowledge management by documenting lessons learnt success stories and emerging practices across projects.
	Undertake other research and programme-support tasks assigned by the supervisor.


Qualifications


	Bachelor’s degree in Social Science, Agricultural Economics, Development Studies or related field.
	NYSC member with valid deployment to Abuja and graduates with a maximum of 1 year of post-NYSC work experience.


Competencies:
The successful candidate should demonstrate:


	Analytical thinking: Ability to investigate issues, analyse information and draw evidence-based conclusions.
	Research and writing: Ability to translate complex information into clear, concise and useful outputs.
	Learning agility: Willingness to learn quickly and work across multiple technical areas.
	Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively with Programme Managers, Advisors and project teams.
	Initiative: Ability to identify information gaps and proactively support the team in addressing them.
	Attention to detail: Ability to produce accurate and well-structured research and programme outputs.


Additional Information:
Internship Engagement Terms:


	This is a learning placement for a period of 12 months, designed to build capacity and practical experience.
	While it does not constitute employment, the intern/ NYSC member will gain valuable exposure to international development general office operations practices and systems, with mentoring and supervision provided by the experienced team.
	Applicable to Nigeria Nationals only.


This internship offers a unique opportunity to


	Learn programme implementation within international development.
	Build expertise in conducting research.
	Strengthen your capabilities in analysing data.
	Receive mentorship from professionals within team environment.
	Develop proficiency in team building and stakeholder collaboration.
	Contribute to work that makes a difference.


Click here to apply online

Note: only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 

 

2.) Administrative Assistant Intern

Job Location: Abuja
Job type: Full-time

Job Description


	SNV Nigeria is seeking a recruit Administrative Assistant for Internship/National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) for its Country Programme, to provide day-to-day key administrative and programme support.
	The Officer will be responsible for the supporting with general administration, operational activities and support project teams. 


Purpose of the internship Placement 


	In your role as a Administrative Assistant, you will gain practical experience in administration, general operations, stakeholder coordination and programme implementation within an international development organisation.
	The intern will be based in Abuja, work with the Operations Officer and Country Programme team. These includes working with Programme Managers, Advisors and project teams across SNV Nigeria’s portfolio, contributing to a range of initiatives that strengthens SNV’s objectives and visibility.
	The intern will report to the Operations Officer and will take on, a mix of recurring administrative tasks within the dynamic programmes. Each week will offer opportunities to learn, co-create, and contribute in meaningful ways.
	To succeed in this role, you should bring a flexible and proactive mindset, a collaborative spirit, and a genuine passion for our mission to advance sustainable and equitable development, making impact that matters. 


This internship offers a unique opportunity to:


	Learn programme implementation within international development.
	Build expertise in general office operations.
	Strengthen your capabilities in coordinating, organising meetings and events.
	Receive mentorship from professionals in a team environment.
	Develop proficiency in team building and stakeholder collaboration.
	Contribute to work that makes a difference.


Job Description
General Administrative Support: 


	Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Country office and project teams.
	Prepare meeting logistics, attendance sheets, agendas and minutes.
	Support travel arrangements, hotel bookings and related logistics for staff, consultants and project participants.
	Maintain organised electronic and physical filing systems in line with SNV procedures for country programme and projects, including data management and filing.
	Support the preparation, processing and tracking of administrative forms and requests.  
	Provide any other administrative support as required by the office program.


Programme and Project Support:


	Support Program and Project team with meetings, workshops and related events. 
	Assist with collecting and organising programme data; and maintaining comprehensive data on the various projects partners and clients. 
	Assist with preparing project-related documents, presentations, trackers and reports.
	Support the preparation of project documentation for internal review and reporting.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's degree or HND in Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Management, Public Administration, Development Studies, Social Sciences or a related field.
	NYSC member with valid deployment to Abuja and graduates with a maximum of 1-2 year of post-NYSC work experience.
	Previous administrative, operational, project or office-support experience is an advantage but not essential.


Competencies:
The successful candidate should demonstrate:


	Strong organisational and administrative skills.
	Good attention to detail and accuracy.
	Good written and verbal communication skills.
	Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
	Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
	Good interpersonal and teamwork skills.
	Ability to work effectively with colleagues across different projects.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
	Willingness to learn and work within established policies and procedures.
	High level of integrity, confidentiality and professionalism.


Click here to apply online

 

 

3.) Communications Intern 

Job Location: Abuja

Job type: Full-time

Job Description


	SNV Nigeria is seeking a dynamic and digitally savvy Communication applicants for Internship/National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) for its Country Programme to support its communications, branding and marketing materials with an aim to achieve an enabling environment for SNV’s business development.


Purpose of the Internship Placement 


	In your role as a Communications Intern, you will gain practical experience in communications within the international development sector. The intern will be based in Abuja, work with the Communication team and Country Programme team. These includes working with Programme Managers, Advisors and project teams across SNV Nigeria’s portfolio, contributing to a range of initiatives that strengthens SNV’s objectives and visibility.
	The intern will report to the Country Director and will take on, a mix of recurring tasks and new, dynamic projects. Each week will offer opportunities to learn, co-create, and contribute in meaningful ways.
	To succeed in this role, you should bring a flexible and proactive mindset, a collaborative spirit, and a genuine passion for our mission to advance sustainable and equitable development, making impact that matters. 


This internship offers a unique opportunity to:


	Learn within the international development.
	Build expertise in global marketing and communications.
	Strengthen your capabilities in content creation, digital storytelling, and project coordination.
	Learn how to tailor content for different platforms and audiences.
	Receive mentorship from professionals in a team environment.
	Develop proficiency in team building and stakeholder collaboration.
	Contribute to work that makes a difference.


Job Description
Communications and digital Support: 


	Support the development of engaging content using pictures and info graphs which aligns with the various SNV Nigeria’s digital platforms. This includes, website, ViVa Engage, facebook and Instagram.
	Support the development of impact and success stories of the project. This could be featured in reports, newsletters, factsheets and targeted visibility materials.  
	Support management and advisors on the application of corporate brand on promotional activities such as project updates, case studies, briefs, presentations and other communication materials.
	Collaborate with and support staff with communication activities such as basic graphics, infographics, presentations and short videos using digital design and editing tools.
	Monitor SNV Nigeria’s digital engagement and support basic analytics and reporting.


Programme and Knowledge Management:


	Capture, organise and upload photographs, and videos on SharePoint for project activities such as online publications, presentations, exhibitions, reports, etc.
	Support Programme Managers and Advisors to identify compelling project results, human-interest stories and learnings that can be communicated to wider audiences.
	Support documentation of workshops, field visits, stakeholder meetings and project events.
	Assist in converting technical programme information into clear, accessible and engaging communication content.
	Support the preparation of presentations, briefing materials and other programme documentation.
	supporting the development, documentation and dissemination of programme activities.
	Assist teams in maintaining project information and digital records.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree or Higher National Diploma in Communication, Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Digital Media, Marketing, Development Studies or a related field.
